payout_quote: Official Club Z! tutoring jobs page (tutors.clubztutoring.com): 'Our Club Z! tutors earn between $16-$30 per hour depending on their specific qualifications and tutoring subject level.'
steps: Apply on the Club Z! tutors jobs page for your area.
Complete the tutor application, screening, and background check.
Get matched with local students for in-home or online tutoring.
Tutor sessions at $16-$30/hr based on your qualifications and subject level.
catches: The $16-$30/hr depends on your qualifications and subject level — entry tutors start at the lower end.
Work is match-based; hours are not guaranteed and depend on local student demand.
In-home tutoring involves travel time that is unpaid.
Franchise-based: exact terms may vary by local Club Z! office.
biggest_catch: The $16-$30/hr is a qualifications-dependent range, not a guarantee — you start near $16/hr without advanced credentials, and hours depend entirely on being matched with local students.
eligibility: Subject qualifications; pass application, screening, and background check.
timing: Paid per tutoring session at contracted hourly rate.
